purpose: Durable source-review memory. Records which source windows/topics have already been screened or reviewed, what they established, what remains unresolved, and when a review may be reopened. This ledger prevents future agents from restarting source research from zero.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Body Collection component definitions: ซอก / ไส้ / คู่
entries.finding: Source defines the shown ซอก as a same-color close/open price joint, คู่ as an opposite-color support/resistance pair with an equal/aligned open-close equilibrium reference while residual body extension may differ, and ไส้ as completed-candle wick structure. The taught Body Collection construction requires ซอก + ไส้ + คู่.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Why current Body Collection uses two forecast references instead of older three-part placement
entries.finding: Source explicitly contrasts the current two-reference Body Collection method with an older generic head/middle/tail three-part placement. The current method is anchored to historical ซอก/ไส้/คู่ structure; reviewed source does not state a generic arithmetic three-component-price to two-reference transform. The later-reviewed 00:46:48 visual shows the three-horizontal-level versus two-horizontal-level comparison but does not establish an exact universal selection formula.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Worked PA Sell Body Collection assembly and two forecast references
entries.finding: In the reviewed PA Sell worked example, ซอก and คู่ share the upper shown reference around 3563.59 and a distinct wick-derived reference is around 3560.31, producing the demonstrated forecast area. This is shown-example geometry only and is not a universal assembly law.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Body Collection zone arrival plus M1/M5 PA/brake confirmation
entries.finding: Reviewed source supports zone-first confirmation rather than touch-and-enter: lower-timeframe PA/brake structure is required in the shown setup. The visual supports failure to make a higher high plus PA Sell/engulfing structure before continuation.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Hierarchical cross-timeframe completion of ซอก + ไส้ + คู่
entries.finding: Source directly demonstrates H4 incomplete -> H1 supplies ซอก + ไส้ -> M30 supplies คู่ -> completed Body Collection zone. Synchronized comparison now further shows two H1 reference lines already present before the M30 pair is identified; the pair is called ตรงกัน and aligns/co-locates with an existing parent reference, with no third forecast line added. This closes the shown parent-SOK+WICK/lower-PAIR topology but not machine equality or other component permutations.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Whether wick is only spacing metadata and repeated two-reference use
entries.finding: Direct Q&A rejects treating the wick as merely a spacing helper; the source says the construction must be marked/considered as a whole. The same sequence reiterates two forecast lines/references.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Body Collection zone lifecycle, reuse, and replanning
entries.finding: Unused historical Body Collection references may remain usable; once Body Collection has completed/been used, the source says the zone is no longer reused and the view should be changed/replanned. Touch alone is not established as automatic retirement.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Body Collection search window and H4 -> H1 -> M30 fallback
entries.finding: Source says if H4 lacks all three conditions, inspect H1; if H1 remains incomplete, inspect M30. Initial historical search is roughly 2-4 candles and may continue farther back if absent. No universal same-timeframe winner rule is established when multiple valid candidates coexist.

entries.source_title: PA/PAT lesson
entries.topic: PAT2/PAT3 strict >50% semantics and denominator basis
entries.finding: Source supports strict beyond-half semantics and body-oriented language. The measured PAT2 schematic reclaims about 69% of the prior body, but the same image also appears to pass the full high-low midpoint, so the reviewed visual cannot distinguish the canonical denominator.

entries.source_title: PA/PAT lesson
entries.topic: SIG Entry two source-taught modes and structural SL reference
entries.finding: Source teaches two SIG entry modes: entry while the prospective post-SIG candle is still forming/body-collecting, and entry after the post-SIG candle confirms with the following candle. In the discussed Mode-2 setup, confirmed post-SIG wick = point-check = structural SL reference.

entries.source_title: System summary
entries.topic: Active post-SIG point-check destruction by touch/contact
entries.finding: Source explicitly distinguishes contact/touch from near miss: even a small wick contact destroys the active point-check reference, while an almost-touch without contact survives. This rejects a universal positive 200-point destruction buffer.

entries.source_title: PA/PAT lesson
entries.topic: Independent confirmation that post-SIG point-check survives when price does not touch
entries.finding: Independent source sequence supports the same semantic: if price returns but does not touch the post-SIG point-check/wick reference, the reference remains active.

entries.source_title: EP.4 M5 brake
entries.topic: Entry #2 retest topology and Point #1 structural SL reference
entries.finding: Slides and chart examples confirm Point #2 as the preferred retest entry signal in the taught form and Point #1 as the structural SL reference. Retest requires break/move-away and return to the switched structural level; the relevant confirmation candle must close before acting.

entries.source_title: EP.2 Trend/Frame/SIG plus PA/PAT lesson
entries.topic: Sideway frame body-primary versus body-core plus wick structural layer methods
entries.finding: Reviewed source supports body-primary/body-envelope Sideway construction and a body-core plus optional wick structural layer/envelope method. Full visible wick extrema are not universally the frame boundaries. Sideway is dynamic/multi-level and can expand or role-flip after actual break/retest.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Second shown parent ซอก+ไส้ two-reference structure with lower-TF completion
entries.finding: PA Sell PAT2 example visibly has two forecast/reference lines before lower-TF completion is discussed. The instructor identifies one as ไส้ and one as ซอก, then says the missing structure also exists in H1. This independently repeats the family in which the parent/reference TF supplies two levels and a lower-TF component completes the set rather than adding a third visible line.

entries.source_title: EP.4 เบรก M5 เงินล้าน
entries.topic: Complete three-component higher/reference zone versus partial lower-TF minor S/R
entries.finding: Source says full ซอก+ไส้+คู่ is required for the strong/full zone, then explicitly distinguishes lower-TF minor S/R where pair alone or wick+pair can be used; higher TF should retain the complete set.

entries.source_title: EP.6 ขยี้จุดเข้า M1 M5
entries.topic: Partial component combinations, same-zone grouping, nearest-first S/R selection, and TF overlap strength
entries.finding: Source explicitly names incomplete combinations such as wick+pair and pair+sok as weaker than full three-component structure; says pair/sok/wicks can lie in the same area; accepts nearby alternatives; says choose nearest first in the reviewed S/R context; and describes Day+H4 overlap as stronger. None of this establishes a universal Body Collection candidate winner or numeric alignment tolerance.

entries.source_title: EP.6 ขยี้จุดเข้า M1 M5
entries.topic: Body Collection two zones remain separate from PA confirmation
entries.finding: Source discusses old H1/H4 structural overlap and says Body Collection has two zones, but the example had almost no PA Sell at those zones. This supports zone-first plus confirmation and does not turn S/R component presence into automatic entry.

entries.source_title: EP.5 วิชาเก็บบอดี้
entries.topic: Normal Body Collection route-out versus zone reuse in separate Sideway workflow
entries.finding: Source says not to continue normal Body Collection when the setup has become Sideway. Later Q&A says the zone condition may still be used for a Sideway-style entry, while genuine PA/SIG must be assessed. The statements reconcile as workflow routing versus retained zone/location context.

entries.source_title: EP.5 Body Collection + EP.4 M5 brake + EP.6 M1/M5 entry + system summary
entries.topic: Exact Body Collection touched/revalidated -> collected/used lifecycle geometry
entries.window: targeted full-transcript keyword scan with EP.5 focus at 01:13:16-01:13:41; 01:17:31-01:21:46; 02:01:22-02:02:03
entries.finding: Current batch closes semantic lifecycle (touch is not automatic retirement; completed/used is retired/replanned; fresh unused may persist) but does not state a universal OHLC event for TOUCHED/REVALIDATED -> COLLECTED/USED or exact post-touch S/R revalidation. Zone arrival/contact and PA confirmation cannot be silently promoted to the missing lifecycle transition.

entries.source_title: PA/PAT + EP.4 M5 brake + EP.6 M1/M5 entry + EP.5 Body Collection + system summary
entries.topic: Family-specific signal/knowledge timing versus exact broker execution fill
entries.window: targeted full-transcript execution scan; key windows 1E 00:53:09-01:06:40; EP4 00:38:25-00:45:17 and 01:08:28+; EP6 entry/retest examples; EP5 00:56:35-00:59:43
entries.finding: Source closes family-specific entry timing: SIG Mode1 can enter during the forming next/post-SIG body-collection candle after PA confirmation; SIG Mode2 waits for post-SIG confirmation then uses the following candle; M5 Entry2 signal is known after closed retest confirmation; EP5 zone requires lower-TF PA/brake confirmation. No universal exact broker-fill equation or structural tick tolerance is taught. Worked/live entry prices are contextual examples.

entries.source_title: Exness-MT5Trial6 XAUUSDm runtime symbol metadata + validated M1 pipeline
entries.topic: Broker/feed normalization for literal source equality and contact semantics
entries.window: runtime metadata captured 2026-09-02; XAUUSDm M1 validation sample 2026-08-24 through 2026-08-28
entries.finding: For verified runtime metadata, literal same-price relations can use zero broker-tick difference and literal Bid-chart bar contact can use normalized High-Low inclusion. Current XAUUSDm has digits=3 and trade_tick_size=0.001. No positive fuzzy tolerance is added. Bid/Ask execution, same-bar ordering, generic zone tolerance, production-symbol equivalence, and course-point conversion remain separate/open.

entries.source_title: System summary + EP.2 Trend/Frame/SIG + EP.4 M5 brake + EP.6 M1/M5 entry + PA/PAT lesson
entries.topic: Sideway exit confirmation, internal SIG, wick-only excursion, false-break boundary
entries.window: targeted transcript scan; key windows vcd ~00:58:55-01:01:16 and 01:31:30-01:54:48; EP2 ~01:32:42-01:34:09 and 01:51:08-01:56:53; EP4 Sideway/retest windows
entries.finding: Internal PA/SIG inside an identified Sideway is not automatically an exit. The carrying SIG is identified after actual frame escape, not before. A reviewed higher-TF example shows wick-only excursion with body not following and return-inside as insufficient clean exit evidence. Break->retest->role-flip is source-backed. Exact universal frame-complete, false-break, breakout body/close, confirming-candle count, retest tolerance and cross-TF priority remain source-incomplete.

backfill_policy: Backfill older source windows only from preserved checkpoint evidence when the topic is next touched or through an explicit bounded backfill task. Do not invent timestamp, modality, or closure metadata to make coverage appear complete.
